about: The groom applies for a marriage contract under Sharia, with the registrar at the venue in Abu Dhabi or by video call.
note: Requirements read from the public TAMM service page on the checked date. The form itself sits behind UAE PASS sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

documents: Emirates IDs of the groom, bride, her guardian (wali) and the witnesses
Passports of the groom, bride and her guardian
Visit visa or UAE entry stamp for non-residents
timing: An appointment is booked after approval
channels: Sign in with UAE PASS on TAMM (website or app)
Provided by Abu Dhabi Judicial Department
